faq.q: How long does it take to potty train a French Bulldog?
faq.a: It varies a lot. Merck says a few weeks with patience and consistency, while Humane World puts it at 4 to 6 months for a fully reliable dog. Plan for a few months with a Frenchie.

faq.q: How often should I take my French Bulldog puppy out to pee?
faq.a: At least every hour or two, plus right after waking, eating and playing. As a rough guide, a puppy can hold it for about one hour per month of age.

faq.q: Are French Bulldogs hard to potty train?
faq.a: They can be. The AKC says the breed can be stubborn and may need more training than others. A strict schedule, instant rewards and no punishment make the biggest difference.

faq.q: Should I use pee pads for my French Bulldog puppy?
faq.a: Pads can help short term in an apartment or before vaccines are complete. To switch to outdoors, move the pad toward the door gradually and reward your puppy heavily for going outside.

faq.q: What should I clean dog pee with?
faq.a: An enzymatic cleaner that breaks down the odor. Avoid ammonia, bleach, vinegar and steam cleaners, which can leave a smell that draws your puppy back.
